summary: Greenfire Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a Business Acquisition Report detailing its completed acquisition of all Class A common shares of Connacher Oil and Gas Limited on August 5, 2026, for $1.297 billion in cash, including working capital adjustments. The acquisition adds Connacher's Great Divide oil sands project, adjacent to Greenfire's Hangingstone facilities. Financing included a $575 million bridge facility and amended revolving credit facilities. Greenfire also commenced a rights offering for approximately $775 million in gross proceeds, with first proceeds repaying the bridge facility. Watch for rights offering subscription and integration synergies.
